# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c27 P31](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0031), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie possesses a heavier build, which leads her classmates to consider her unsuited for roles requiring a slim figure. Despite her weight, she demonstrates impressive physical balance when stepping across narrow wooden fences.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is defiant, caustic, and outspoken, often provoking others with bold challenges and blunt remarks. She frequently displays spiteful or mocking behavior toward her peers, such as giggling when classmates are reprimanded or making critical comments about their appearance and background. She rarely hesitates to ask direct questions and shows little restraint in boasting about her successes or family resources. Beneath her sharp tongue, she is capable of feeling severe guilt when she fears her dares have placed someone in physical danger.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P33](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0033), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c35 P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

- Caustic-tongued  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- Defiant  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>

- Dexterity and balance at walking wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To gain an education at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)</sub>

## History

While attending Brierley school, Flossie cheated during a spelling exercise and was caught by Nell Harcourt, causing her to misspell the word. During an outdoor gathering, she walked a wooden fence with ease to prove her skill and then challenged Nell to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Pembroke's kitchen roof; when Nell fell and was injured, Flossie suffered intense distress and guilt over the potential outcome. She later visited Nell while she was recovering from her fractured ankle. During preparation for a school concert, Flossie became moody when she was denied the role of the fairy queen due to her weight, though she later attended the event and acknowledged Nell's stellar performance. She won top prize for knitted lace at a local fair. Joining the Regent's class, she prepared for the Entrance exam, though she struggled with arithmetic. After taking the exam, she barely passed by a three-point margin. Flossie then attended Regent's Academy in town, boarding at the same house as Frank Stockley, and decided to return for another year of study after finishing her first.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
